items.title: CVE-2026-110936 Siemens Software Center: Siemens Software Center Uncontrolled Search Path Element Vulnerability
items.excerpt: Siemens Software Center contains an uncontrolled search path element vulnerability that could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

items.title: ClickFix Attackers Exploit Siemens Software Center Flaw to Deploy Remote Access Trojan
items.excerpt: Siemens has addressed a DLL sideloading vulnerability impacting Siemens Software Center that it said has been exploited in ClickFix attacks. [facts: CVE-2026-110936; 4; 8.4]

items.title: Siemens Software Center
items.excerpt: View CSAF Summary The affected application loads dynamic-link libraries (DLLs) from an uncontrolled search path. This could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application. Siemens has released a new version for Siemens Software Center and recommends to update to the latest version.
